noise.interpretation: Observed $400E mode-bit writes only; they do not establish audible noise or recover an instrument.

dmc.interpretation: Observed $4015 bit-4 requests only; enabling an already active DMC does not restart it. Sample bytes, actual starts, bank mappings and sample counts are not inferred.

limitations: Only APU writes retained in this bounded trace are included. Unvisited audio and a trace with no APU writes remain unknown.
Writer sites are observed CPU instructions, not inferred routine boundaries, song/SFX IDs, a complete audio library or recognized engine families.
Source offsets are observed emulator mappings; CPU addresses alone cannot identify banked ROM code. Unmapped CPU sites and unknown origins remain separate.
Register writes do not establish audible output, note boundaries, instrument definitions or editable music. Expansion audio is not collected by this base-APU observer.
Audio-focused mode excludes PPU write evidence; emulated graphics and audio execution continue unchanged. Existing emulator timing and mapper limitations apply.
